'''Sammul Sharsha's husband''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Lord]] of the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]], who [[Death/Legends|died]] a natural death, something unusually uncommon among [[Sith/Legends|Sith]]. His [[Marriage/Legends|wife]] [[Sammul Sharsha|Sammul]] assumed the position of her husband in the [[Circle of Lords]] after his passing. With her he sired two children, one of whom was an artisan, the other a [[Sith Saber]].
